result.summary: Found 2 visually broken issues. The most obvious problem is an untranslated localization key shown as a section title, and some feed content appears to be obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The section title displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing label.
issues.suggestion: Replace the localization key with the correct translated string, such as "Popular near you" or the intended localized title.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card/image is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the feed feel clipped at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the bottom navigation.
